lore.vista.viewfinder: A camera block that captures a live view. Link it to a Television with a Hollow Cassette to broadcast what it sees.
lore.vista.television: A screen that shows a live feed from a Viewfinder, or a Picture Tape.
lore.vista.hollow_cassette: A cassette that links a Television to a Viewfinder. Use it on a Viewfinder to link it.
lore.vista.picture_tape: A tape that holds a picture to play on a Television.
lore.vista.mirror: A mirror that reflects the world in front of it.
